newsitem.title: UK: Unions, UPS dispute "day of action" impact.
newsitem.headline: Unions, UPS dispute "day of action" impact.

text.p: Union and company officials disputed the impact in Europe of Thursday's "day of action" against United Parcel Service of America.
A UPS Europe statement said the action was hardly supported by any employees, and added none of the company's domestic or international services were affected.

Union sources said the action largely consisted of brief stoppages, leaflet distribution and information meetings by UPS European staff as well as at the company's U.S. headquarters in Atlanta and in Brazil.
In Germany, the country's OeTV transport union, said 1,000 out of 14,000 UPS workers were took part. Other countries involved were France, the Netherlands, Italy, Spain and Belgium.
There was a small demonstration outside the UPS European headquarters in Brussels with representatives from most of the countries involved, including the U.S.-based Teamsters, union sources said.
The latter's four year contract with UPS is due for renegotiation this July.
A spokesman for the day's organisers International Transport Workers Federation (ITF)told Reuters:"We are pleased with the response and we feel it has been a success".
